query: Читай CSV-файлы из директории /data/input/orders/, оставляй только строки где поле status равно COMPLETED, пиши результат в /data/output/completed_orders.csv.

runs.yaml_pim:
flow:
  id: orders_filter_pipeline
  name: Filter Completed Orders
  description: Read CSV files from input directory, filter only rows with status=COMPLETED,
    write to output CSV
triggers:
- id: trigger_schedule
  type: schedule
  condition: every 15 minutes
sources:
- id: source_csv
  name: Read Orders CSV
  type: CSV
  location: /data/input/orders/
  connection:
    properties:
      format: csv
      delimiter: ','
      encoding: UTF-8
      header: 'true'
processing_elements:
- id: filter_completed
  name: Filter Completed Orders
  operation: Filter
  config:
    condition: status = 'COMPLETED'
sinks:
- id: sink_csv
  name: Write Completed Orders CSV
  type: CSV
  location: /data/output/completed_orders.csv
  connection:
    properties:
      format: csv
      delimiter: ','
      encoding: UTF-8
      header: 'true'
processed_data:
- id: orders_data
  format: csv
links:
- from_id: source_csv
  to_id: filter_completed
  data_ref: orders_data
- from_id: filter_completed
  to_id: sink_csv
  data_ref: orders_data
